issue.title: voice.speak public output leaks raw hosted voice IDs
issue.actual_behavior: voice.speak returns raw resolved voice IDs in result.voice_id and top-level stdout even though runtime_state already exports masked/fingerprint-safe voice metadata.
issue.expected_behavior: voice.speak should return masked/fingerprint-safe voice identifiers across public outputs (result payload and stdout) and avoid exporting raw hosted voice IDs.
repro_steps: Create a temp builder env file with fake ElevenLabs key and voice id.
Call voice.speak with provider defaults and inspect response stdout plus result payload.
Before fix, result.voice_id and stdout include raw configured voice ids; after fix, only masked/fingerprint-safe values are returned.
issue.affected_workflow: voice.speak response contract and privacy-safe diagnostics

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: result.voice_id and stdout exposed raw provider voice IDs. After: result.voice_id/result.voice_id_masked and stdout expose masked IDs, and result.voice_id_fingerprint exposes a short fingerprint.

proposed_fix.approach: Set public speak response voice identifier from runtime_state masked metadata, use masked voice IDs in stdout, and add an explicit fingerprint field.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: python -m pytest -q tests/test_spark_hook.py -k 'voice_speak'; python -m py_compile src/voice_comms_chip/spark_hook.py tests/test_spark_hook.py; git diff --check
